import adsk.core, adsk.fusion, json
def pt(x,y): return adsk.core.Point3D.create(x/10.0,-y/10.0,0)
def make_ring(root,name,ring):
    sk=root.sketches.add(root.xYConstructionPlane); sk.name=name
    ls=sk.sketchCurves.sketchLines
    for a,b in zip(ring,ring[1:]):
        ls.addByTwoPoints(pt(a[0],a[1]),pt(b[0],b[1]))
    return sk
def inspect(sk):
    out=[]
    for i in range(sk.profiles.count):
        p=sk.profiles.item(i); bb=p.boundingBox
        out.append({'i':i,'area':p.areaProperties().area,'bb':[[bb.minPoint.x,bb.minPoint.y],[bb.maxPoint.x,bb.maxPoint.y]],'loops':p.profileLoops.count})
    return out
def run(_context):
    app=adsk.core.Application.get(); doc=app.documents.add(adsk.core.DocumentTypes.FusionDesignDocumentType)
    des=adsk.fusion.Design.cast(doc.products.itemByProductType('DesignProductType')); root=des.rootComponent
    data=json.load(open('/Users/daiki/Projects/sage60/pcb/mx_plate/gasket_v1/mx_plate_gasket_geometry.json'))
    ring=data['rings_pcb_mm'][0]
    sk=make_ring(root,'PLATE_OUTER_TEST',ring)
    p=sk.profiles.item(0); bb=p.boundingBox
    oc=adsk.core.ObjectCollection.create(); loop=p.profileLoops.item(0)
    for i in range(loop.profileCurves.count): oc.add(loop.profileCurves.item(i).sketchEntity)
    out={'raw':inspect(sk),'curves':loop.profileCurves.count}
    direction=adsk.core.Point3D.create(bb.minPoint.x-1,bb.minPoint.y-1,0)
    res=sk.offset(oc,direction,0.15)
    out['offset_curves']=res.count if res else None
    out['after']=inspect(sk)
    print(json.dumps(out))
    doc.close(False)
